narrative_purpose: Capture the chapter's essence at a glance: a living animal the size of a hill floating above a cloud sea with a village slung beneath it, held up by nothing but displaced air.
subject: One colossal jellyfish-like aerial creature: a broad translucent pale dome roughly fifty metres across, faintly lit from within, with a long curtain of thin trailing tentacles hanging far below it. Slung beneath the dome in a web of woven fibre bands are three small platforms of wicker and hide, with tiny blue-skinned figures standing on them. Four small flattened ray-shaped flying animals fly ahead of the dome on long taut lines.
scene: High above an endless sea of cloud tops at dusk, distant mountain peaks breaking through the cloud layer far below, an immense open sky.
camera: Wide cinematic establishing shot from slightly above and to the side, the creature placed off-centre with vast open sky around it.
light: Soft dusk light from low on the horizon; the dome glows faintly translucent where light passes through it; one small warm ember point of a cooking fire on a platform is the only warm accent.
palette: Cool teal and deep indigo sky and cloud, pale translucent cyan dome, a single small ember-amber cooking fire glow beneath.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate, serene and observed, not dramatic action art.
detail_level: Crisp on the dome, harness and platforms; cloud sea and distant peaks dissolve into atmospheric haze.
composition: The great dome occupying the upper two thirds off to one side, tentacle curtain and slung platforms below it, tug animals leading on lines toward open sky, generous empty sky.
consistency_notes: This is a LIVING animal, not a built airship: soft translucent organic dome, no rigid frame, no metal, no propellers. The dome has no wings of any kind. Cool Pandora palette with one scarce warm accent.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no labels, no wings, no metal hull, no propellers, no rivets, no 3D-render or photographic look, no cartoon style
